page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Printed page number top left. Below the last line, a gathering mark "W" centred.

main_text.l: civibus est indultum firmitatis robur habere decrevi-
mus, salvo jure eligendi & præsentandi personam ido-
neam loci Diœcesano qui pro tempore fuerit eisdem
Parochianus. Volumus etiam ut personæ, dignitate
& ratione personatus a præmissæ Ecclesiæ, Sacerdote
Legitimo quatuor libræ Groningensium ut olim in festo
sancti Michaelis exhibeantur, & per hoc Ecclesia
ante dicta ab omni jure & potestate personæ sit exem-
pta, & quod præmissa Ecclesia a civibus in Vtinga-
eluch & Westercluch ut prius frequentetur. Vt autem
hæc rata maneant & inconvulsa munimine scripti
nostri & sigilli impressione ea corroboravimus. Si-
quis autem quod huic scripto nostro sit obvium pr-
æsumpserit attemptare, indignationem Dei omnipo-
tentis & nostram excommunicationem se noverit
incursurum. Acta sunt hæc apud Groninge, anno
Domini millesimo ducentesimo quadragesimo sexto
feria quarta post Palmas, Testibus his. Fratre pr-
æposito Tilensi, Hermanno & Gerhardo scriptoribus
nostris a Druine, Alberto & Swethero de Worsts,
Hijseberto de Bucharst, Waltero Radingo & Bartol-
do Radingo & aliis quam pluribus.

page.notes: Several words are uncertain in the scan: "libræ" (after "Groningensium" the line is blurred and reads as "libra" or "librae"), "Worsts" and "Bucharst" (proper names, possibly spelled differently), and "Vtingaeluch" (the hyphen at the line end is partly unclear). These readings are as close as the scan allows; no [?] markers were added because the letters are legible in context. The "W" at the foot may be a gathering mark rather than a catchword; it is recorded as the signature.
